title: Steezy-code/clipper
summary: Local-first AI short-form video clipper — Whisper transcription, LLM clip scoring, OpenCV face tracking, ffmpeg compositing. No cloud, no subscription.

title: darshi1337/apogee
summary: Private AI summarizer for anything you read. Inspired by Mozilla's Orbit.

title: guruthechosen/omarchywritingtool
summary: Apple-style Writing Tools for Hyprland/Omarchy — select text anywhere, hit a keybind, get Translate/Proofread/Correct via Gemini or a local Ollama model.

title: parawanderer/window-ml
summary: An applied mathematician's apparatus for testing ideas about LLM inference. The code is written and maintained by agents and I don't read it; this is research, not a product.

title: sonjari/sonjari
summary: Your PC does the work. You get the proof. Sonjari is a free local AI agent for Windows: web research, Excel and Word documents, and code. Works on its own, or takes on tasks from Claude and Codex. No meter.

title: WindriderQc/AgentX
summary: Local AI workbench: Ollama chat, document retrieval, model evaluation and optional personal and household interfaces.

title: cmcoffee/gohort
summary: Your agent has agents. A self-hosted, local-first AI agent platform in one Go binary: agents hand work to specialists and build the tools, agents and apps they lack, with sandboxed tools and credentials the model never sees.

title: IncarnaMind/IncarnaMind
summary: IncarnaMind is a free, open-source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux where you write with AI and ask questions about your own documents (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and more). It can check every sentence and figure in a draft against those documents, whoever wrote it, and every answer cites the exact page it comes from.

title: scottdensmore/PetSpotR
summary: Event-driven AI application for reporting and matching lost pets using Go, GCP, and Gemma.

title: Cabrly/kaizen
summary: Kanban + planos de estudo montados por IA (Ollama local ou Gemini/ChatGPT). Roda no PC e no celular, inclusive iPhone.

title: CatVinci-Studio/Textus
summary: The next-generation Markdown editor, with an AI writing assistant. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.

title: thanhloi2055-blip/phish-guardian-ollama
summary: AI Phishing Defense Toolkit 2026: Detect Email Threats with Local LLM Analysis

title: iDiagoValeta/localOllamaRAG
summary: Local multimodal RAG for PDFs: MinerU, embeddinggemma-2, FAISS, BM25, BGE reranking and Ollama. Runs on your hardware via web and desktop; summaries, outlines and quizzes of any document.

title: scs0209/dropzone-zero
summary: A local agent that keeps your Downloads folder tidy, with every move reversible.

title: chedim/membrane
summary: ... Renaming to babyseat: does your AI seat come with a Blurp?

title: phinn/KinetAios
summary: Local-first multi-engine AI agent dashboard — Claude Code, Codex & built-in ReAct in one window. MCP support, skills auto-loading, long-term memory. No account, no relay.

title: raro42/mac-stats
summary: Menu-bar system monitor for Apple Silicon (optional local AI agent). Rust + Tauri. No cloud telemetry.

title: a77chand/huddle
summary: Open-source safety companion for nights out: shared check-in sessions, honest escalation, Bluetooth "last seen near", and open-weight AI (Whisper + Gemma) that turns voice notes into actionable alert cards. Expo app + self-hostable server.

title: jasonssdev/openkos
summary: Local-first engine that turns your scattered text into a living, portable knowledge base in the Open Knowledge Format (OKF)

title: jossssdl/vramlens
summary: CLI to diagnose VRAM for local LLMs: reads GGUF headers (local or remote via HTTP Range, no full download), computes weights + KV-cache growth (FP16/Q8/Q4) from 2k to 128k context, and predicts the exact point where inference offloads to CPU. Written in Go.
